note: Maps each sprite id to its picture, size and anchor. `file: null` means the game draws a placeholder in code (src/game/placeholderArt.ts and src/game/render.ts) at this size. To swap in final art: put the WebP in public/art/, set `file` to its name (and `highlight` for a cloud's highlight layer), keep or adjust the size and anchor. No code changes. `frames`: a strip of frames side by side, played at `fps`. `points`: named places on the sprite as fractions (a Cloudling's hand). `repeat`: stretched or tiled between two points. Entries with `status: planned` are not drawn yet. docs/ASSET_LIST.md is generated from this file: `npm run assets:list`.

cloud.stratocumulus.internet-gateway.description: Internet Gateway: a low stratocumulus on the VPC's lower edge, where kites come in from the ground.

cloud.stratocumulus.nat-gateway.description: NAT Gateway: a smaller stratocumulus in a public subnet; private clouds reach the internet through it.

cloud.cumulus.load-balancer.description: Application Load Balancer: a broad cumulus across both public subnets; every kite string meets it.

cloud.altocumulus.ec2-instance.description: One EC2 instance: a patch of altocumulus. One instance is one graphic.

cloud.altocumulus.auto-scaling-group.description: An Auto Scaling group, as its palette icon and while it is dragged into place. In the sky, a group is drawn as one fleet-instance cloudlet per instance.

cloud.altocumulus.fleet-instance.description: One instance in an Auto Scaling group's fleet: a single small cloudlet, drawn once per instance, so 4 instances are 4 cloudlets and 8 are 8. This is its largest size; a crowded fleet draws it smaller.

cloud.cumulonimbus.s3-bucket.description: S3 bucket: a tall cumulonimbus with an anvil top, spanning every band of sky.

cloud.cirrus.iam-role.description: IAM role: wispy cirrus in the high band; a thread runs down from it to the clouds that wear it.

cloud.altostratus.rds-database.description: RDS database: a flat, layered altostratus in a private subnet. A Multi-AZ standby is the same graphic, drawn faint in the other zone.

cloud.cirrostratus.kms-key.description: KMS key (customer managed): a thin cirrostratus veil in the high band, with a faint halo in the key's colour. Every cloud encrypted with this key wears the same halo.

construct.waf-net.states: Idle and changed (golden sunlight), tinted in code like a cloud.
construct.waf-net.description: AWS WAF web ACL: a woven net slung just beneath the load balancer. Red kites it blocks are caught in it, then fall.

construct.nacl-ribbon.description: Network ACL: a ribbon fence along a subnet's boundary. Repeated along each edge; a custom ACL's ribbon is drawn stronger than the default ACL's. Kites a NACL blocks tangle in it.

construct.wisp-bridge.description: Connected: a wisp bridge grown between two clouds (a Multi-AZ database's primary and standby). Stretched between them.

construct.skyway.description: Skyway: the private path from a subnet to S3 through a gateway endpoint. Stretched between them.

construct.cirrus-thread.description: Cirrus thread: from an IAM role down to each cloud that wears it. Stretched between them.

construct.bucket-shell.description: S3 Block Public Access: a pale protective shell that closes over the bucket; kites slide off it.

overlay.compromised-smoke.description: Compromised: dark, smoky edges laid over a cloud a hostile kite got into, so the state never depends on the red tint alone. Stretched to the cloud.

effect.lightning.ground.description: Availability Zone failure: lightning from the sky to the ground over the failed zone. Stretched from top to ground.

effect.lightning.cloud.description: Failover: lightning arcing from cloud to cloud (primary to standby). Stretched between them.

effect.rain.description: Response returned: a short column of rain falling from a cloud onto the Cloudling below.

ui.padlock.description: Locked: this cloud cannot be changed in this level.

cloudling.friendly.idle.description: A friendly Cloudling, standing, holding the string. The costume is a separate overlay per region.

cloudling.friendly.cheer.description: A friendly Cloudling, jumping and cheering: its kite was answered. The costume is a separate overlay per region.

cloudling.friendly.droop.description: A friendly Cloudling, drooping sadly: its kite was stopped or timed out. The costume is a separate overlay per region.

cloudling.hostile.idle.description: A hostile Cloudling, in a black hoodie, hood up, only eyes visible, holding the string.

cloudling.hostile.stamp.description: A hostile Cloudling, stamping and huffing: its kite was stopped.

cloudling.hostile.snicker.description: A hostile Cloudling, snickering: its kite got in (a breach).

cloudling.costume.us-east-1.description: N. Virginia costume overlay (raincoat yellow), drawn over every friendly Cloudling in Levels set in N. Virginia.

cloudling.costume.eu-central-1.description: Frankfurt costume overlay (brick red), drawn over every friendly Cloudling in Levels set in Frankfurt.

cloudling.costume.sa-east-1.description: São Paulo costume overlay (teal), drawn over every friendly Cloudling in Levels set in São Paulo.

cloudling.costume.ap-northeast-1.description: Tokyo costume overlay (indigo), drawn over every friendly Cloudling in Levels set in Tokyo.

kite.friendly.flying.description: A green diamond kite, flying on its string.

kite.friendly.tangled.description: A green diamond kite, tangled in a network ACL's ribbon.

kite.friendly.netted.description: A green diamond kite, caught in WAF's net beneath the load balancer.

kite.friendly.crumpled.description: A green diamond kite, crumpled, falling to the ground.

kite.hostile.flying.description: A red kite shaped like a bird, flying on its string.

kite.hostile.tangled.description: A red kite shaped like a bird, tangled in a network ACL's ribbon.

kite.hostile.netted.description: A red kite shaped like a bird, caught in WAF's net beneath the load balancer.

kite.hostile.crumpled.description: A red kite shaped like a bird, crumpled, falling to the ground.

station.body.description: The weather station's post, tripod feet and the arm the bell hangs from. Static.

station.anemometer.description: Three cups at the top of the post, spinning faster with more kites in the air. Frames show one turn.

station.dial.description: The CPU dial's face, 0% at lower left round to 100% at lower right. The coloured bands and the scaling target's tick are drawn over it in code.

station.needle.description: The dial's hand. Turned about its anchor (the pivot) to show CPU; it swings up during a CPU spike.

station.bell.description: The alarm bell, hanging from its anchor; it swings while CloudWatch's alarm rings.

scene.us-east-1.skyline.description: N. Virginia: a faint, low-contrast skyline on the horizon: a low row of data-centre buildings, with the Washington Monument and Capitol dome faint in the far distance. Its bottom sits on the horizon.

scene.us-east-1.ground.description: N. Virginia: the grassy ground strip, fresh green, from the horizon to the bottom of the stage.

scene.eu-central-1.skyline.description: Frankfurt: a faint, low-contrast skyline on the horizon: the banking-district towers and the cathedral spire. Its bottom sits on the horizon.

scene.eu-central-1.ground.description: Frankfurt: the grassy ground strip, deeper green, from the horizon to the bottom of the stage.

scene.sa-east-1.skyline.description: São Paulo: a faint, low-contrast skyline on the horizon: a dense, wide high-rise skyline. Its bottom sits on the horizon.

scene.sa-east-1.ground.description: São Paulo: the grassy ground strip, olive and ochre, from the horizon to the bottom of the stage.

scene.ap-northeast-1.skyline.description: Tokyo: a faint, low-contrast skyline on the horizon: Tokyo Skytree and the high-rise skyline. Its bottom sits on the horizon.

scene.ap-northeast-1.ground.description: Tokyo: the grassy ground strip, muted sage, from the horizon to the bottom of the stage.

ui.narrator.idle.description: The narrator in the bottom box, idling.

cloudling.operator.idle.description: The operator Cloudling (Level 9): a distinct hat, holding a box-shaped kite.

kite.hostile.stolen.description: A hostile kite carrying stolen raindrops down its string after a breach.

construct.kms-halo.description: KMS halo: a faint ring around a cloud whose data is encrypted with a KMS key, in that key's colour (Level 8). Stretched to fit around the cloud: tall round the bucket, flat round the database.

construct.efs-mist.description: EFS: a shared mist between instances in both zones (Level 10).

construct.ebs-wisp.description: EBS: a small wisp tied beneath one instance (Level 10).

effect.wind-lines.description: Forwarded: a breeze along visible wind lines to the next cloud.

construct.vpc-border.description: The VPC's atlas-style dashed border (drawn in code for now).

construct.az-divider.description: The faint dotted line between Availability Zones (drawn in code for now).

ui.narrator.pointing.description: The narrator pointing at something in the sky.

ui.narrator.pleased.description: The narrator pleased, for a finished level.

ui.title-logo.description: The title logo for the start screen.
